cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Choose the biscuits carefully. The winning plate goes to the neighbourhood meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. It's also our first impression of the new committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put your name beside the plate so we can test that publicly.
